title.en: An Act to include Certain Parcel of Lands acquired by Accretion as part of the Territorial Jurisdiction of the City of Sipalay, Amending for the purpose Section 2 of Republic Act No. 9027, Entitled "An Act Covnerting the Municipality of Sipalay, Province of Negros Occidental into a Component City to be known as the City of Sipalay"

text.en: The parcel of lands acquired by reason of accretion as described in the immediately preceding section together with the appurtenances thereto shall belong to the City of Sipalay and thereafter said lands may be sold or leased under such rules and regulations as the city government may promulgate.
The Land Registration Authority is hereby mandated to issue separate titles of the above-described parcel of lands within one year from approval of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
